title: Self-Installation Permit Addition, Homeowner Service Contracts
content:
On a company-elected offer worked out under the rule for replacements no network contractor can install, and only on such an offer, the cash carries the self-installation permit addition for work the homeowner's own installer must now do, and no supplemental allowance is booked; every other cash settlement and every out-of-network reimbursement remains under the general allowance rule. This applies to Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts.

The self-installation permit addition pays for the permits the homeowner must now obtain, at a permit charge of 150.00 each:

| Item | Permits | Permit addition |
|---|---|---|
| heating system or cooling system | 2 | 2 times 150.00, that is 300.00 |
| water heater | 1 | 1 times 150.00, that is 150.00 |
| any other item | none | nothing |

It is added to the company-elected cash basis as a flat dollar amount, never compounded, and the basis so obtained is compared with the remaining item and aggregate benefits without being rounded first.
